title: Bidjara language - Wikipedia
text: Australian Bidjara artist Christian Bumbarra Thompson employs his Bidjara language in his video work in an attempt to redistribute his language into the public realm. His work Gamu Mambu, which means "Blood Song", is a video work of a Dutch Baroque opera singer singing in Bidjara.

title: Iningai - Wikipedia
text: The Iningai (Yiningayi) are an indigenous Australian people of the present-day Longreach Region in the state of Queensland. The traditional lands of the Iningai lay to the west of the Great Dividing Range as far as the Forsyth Range, [1] Maneroo Creek, and Longreach.
